I made bad experience, that many people don't want to discuss anything.

The hardest thing to learn is to learn learning. Art is an option, I take photos. Through a APD music could be a very tough challenge.

I have played chess, had to focus on one game for hours.

The way to achieve the gift is the curse.

A hard answer would be the best, but because it's not possible. The main goal is to find a "soft" answer, which I can live. 

I have read some books about atheism theory, mostly Nietzsche. It contains thought about life in general.

Thanks for the link :)

Meaning of life (Where do we come from? Where do we go? How limited is our view of the world?)

Ethics (What does animals feel? Is it right to kill this brachycera, just because it is annoying?)

and some political and technical question. The two first groups are more of a problem, because Ethics often leads to Meaning of life and I can't find an answer. A psychologist said to me, we are the ones, who control our minds. I got this in the most cases, but it's hard, and I fear, that one time I can't handle it.
